description: Detection: equal-weight ensemble of the hierarchical beta-binomial rate and an inner-CV L2 logistic that uses Rt/R0

model.formula: y_j = ridge(material one-hot + ln(1 + K N0 t) + no_flow + 5(Rt/R0-1.35)), K N0 = 3.75e-3/s (x0.1 no-flow); Dg, AMD via Hatch-Choate; detection: P_j = 0.5 * beta-binomial rate (flow, material, aged hierarchy, a=2) + 0.5 * L2 logistic(material, log aging, no_flow, Rt/R0)
model.notes: Ridge on log Dm, ln sigma_g, log M0; Dg and AMD derived by Hatch-Choate. Per-target alpha by GCV; logistic C by inner 5-fold Brier.
